explanation.headline: FDA shortage list shows Amneal Pharmaceuticals discontinuing nitrofurantoin oral suspension; our label names Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited with NAI inspection 2024-07-26

sentences.text: FDA's shortage list records Amneal Pharmaceuticals discontinuing nitrofurantoin oral suspension with an initial posting date of 2026-04-10.
The product label we hold names Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited as the manufacturer with FEI 3004956904 and a most recent inspection classification of NAI on 2024-07-26.
FDA inspection history for that FEI shows a series of VAI classifications from 2010-05-15 through 2020-03-13.
Corvale East has 353 units on hand at 13.7 units per day for 26 days of supply.
Corvale General has 409 units on hand at 15.9 units per day for 26 days of supply.
Corvale Lakeside has 29 units on hand at 2.5 units per day for 11 days of supply.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Q-04b0dd.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%nitrofurantoin%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%nitrofurantoin%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-a8361f.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('a8a0d7d7-1e18-46a7-a1f8-e97499820035') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-8d2744.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%nitrofurantoin%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-146bbe.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%nitrofurantoin%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-35f4de.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%nitrofurantoin%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%capsule%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-eae2b9.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3004956904') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-870502.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3004956904') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-8eac4b.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3004956904') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('alembic')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-1c93e7.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('alembic') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%nitrofurantoin%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-fa8097.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('62332039031')

Q-d23e70.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%nitrofurantoin%'
